keyPoints: Vritt-aalekh (pie chart) me poore vritt ke 360 ko aankdon ke anupat me baanto — 25% hissa = 90 ka kendriya kon.
Kendriya kon = (ghatak ka maan ÷ kul yog) x 360 — isi se har hisse ka tukda kaatte hain.
Aayta-chitra (histogram) me lagatar varg-antaralon ke dande bina gap ke bante hain — ye bar-graph se alag hai — varg lagatar hon to gap nahi hota.
Prayikta (probability) = anukool parinam ÷ kul sambhav parinam — paase me sam ank aane ki prayikta 3/6 = 1/2.
Tash ke 52 patton me har ikka aane ki prayikta 4/52 = 1/13; laal patta aane ki 26/52 = 1/2.
Sambhavna 0 se 1 ke beech hoti hai — 0 matlab asambhav, 1 matlab nishchit ghatna — jaise suraj ka poorab se nikalna.
Aam galti: pie chart me pratishat ko seedha kon samajh lena — 25% ka kon 25 nahi, 90 degree hota hai.
subject: Maths
title: Aankde: Pie Chart aur Sambhavna
